purpose: Check whether an explicit ordinary event carrier preserves exact Pending/Done boundary observations without representing the event phase as a cubical line.

source_basis.kind: AI-authored M4-lite task materialized after the design freeze
references: /Volumes/D/HoTT独立答复/HoTT非现实性悖论机器统观完整方案/005 - 六条研究线与首轮实验.md

answer_visibility.limitation: The designing AI knew that an explicit Stage repair should be a positive control and authored the later grammar.

input.type_ref: ordinary Stage with start and finish constructors and phase : Stage → Bool
input.available_information: the exact start/finish phase equations and endpoint apartness supplied by the frozen task profile

environment.reality_model: a two-event operational boundary with Pending at start and Done at finish
environment.theory_model: an ordinary inductive Stage carrier inside Cubical Agda
environment.arrival_policy: completion is the finish event; no value is assigned at an unobserved dense interior

observation.value: phase start is false, phase finish is true, and those observations remain apart
observation.trace: only the two declared event boundaries are observed

time_structure.theory: ordinary Stage datatype carrying event identity; no cubical-line continuity premise
time_structure.temporal_order: start precedes finish by the task declaration; the datatype itself is not claimed to define physical time

completion.criterion_ref: retain both endpoint equations and their exact distinction

quantifiers.realization: native Cubical Agda product of the three exact boundary facts

allowed_resources: declared symbolic rules through depth 4 followed by native Cubical checking
prohibited_extra_information: no identification of Stage with I, dense reparameterization, hidden midpoint or postulate
assumptions: Stage is an explicit event structure introduced before search
the case is a representation repair control, not evidence that physical time is globally discrete
obligations: the witness must use all three predeclared endpoint facts and the event-pack rule
removing event_pack must remove every goal witness
the native product target and controls must pass
treating Stage as the cubical dimension must fail
the repair must be classified as explicit new structure rather than recovery from Path alone

known_positive_controls.description: start, finish and apartness facts all type-check in L3M4Support

known_negative_controls.description: dimension abstraction cannot be applied to Stage

correspondence.original_activity: observe an exact transition from Pending at start to Done at finish
theoryization_steps: represent the two event boundaries by an ordinary Stage datatype
retain the two phase equations and endpoint apartness
changed_fields: an explicit event carrier is present instead of asking one cubical line to encode the discontinuity
correspondence.observation_justification: the same Pending/Done criterion used by the original L3 obstruction is fixed before search
correspondence.reality_bridge_detail: The Stage model represents the declared two-boundary activity; it does not establish a physical ontology of time.
open_obligations: determine whether natural HoTT/Cubical consumers already provide such a separate event/clock structure
do not describe the repair as recovery from the original I-indexed observable
